notes: Craft: five scenes on a near-black field with the glass as the only saturated body — the spectrum scene uses a six-colour palette strictly as presentation. No historical window reconstructed; no NASA/analogous asset question arises. E0 acceptance repair: title/field collision fixed on m-gla-0-aperture, m-gla-2-seams, m-gla-5-return (title width 560; formations iteratively scaled and dropped clear of the title band); cover re-captured.

#0 aperture — the light ☀ approaches and enters the made square (position + size); B/p → p→B stages the record's own asymmetry (order of being vs order of recognition); attract/pulse — the light drawn through; no automation (the entry is single).

#1 spectrum — ring layout: the white disc cycles its tint through red, teal, slate — plenitude carrying differentiated colour (QL), never losing one field; ∅# → QL names the harmonic order; attract/implode — the gathering into spectrum; auto-spectrum LFO on circulation (the light's breathing).

#2 seams — grid layout (the lead lattice); ≠ → / at the window's foot: the mere-placement refused becomes the seam — the join that divides-and-holds; the lead ring breathes (holding while marking); repel/shove — obstruction retained; the apparatus/light correction (lead→apparatus, QL→light, MEF within the order, never a certifying superior) carried by e544's name and the binding guard.

#3 projection — the changing cast: e545's tint cycles warm→dark→teal with size shifts (sun, pane, room, viewer changing); 180°→360° the contextual turn; vortex/pulse — the viewer moving among positions; auto-projection LFO on dispersion (the shifting cast).

#5→0 return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the return's direction: the window approached again deepest (z −0.4, brightening), ¶ Dyczkowski's limits at z 0, ◉◉ Bohm at z +0.2, and the declared returns nearest (M05 → C38 at z +0.35 — the declared movements focusing into the local-Bimba office); pointer attract/pulse firmer — recognition returning to the aperture; auto-return LFO on pointerStrength.

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 began with ☀ outside the aperture and the order-stamp B/p (being first); #5→0 returns the viewer to that window — now deepest in the scene, approached, its determinacy brightening — with the recognition-order (p→B) vindicated: the declared returns (M05→C38) sit nearest because the return is where the construction lives; the seams of #2 remain (¶ at z 0 holds Dyczkowski's limits; ◉◉ holds Bohm as resonance, not extraction), so the ending re-reads the aperture without possessing it. The Original remains prior throughout.

Human-amplified guards carried (relation-local): no historical window or sacred programme reconstructed; the sun supplies no warrant for a metaphysical source outside Consciousness; no additional symbolism assigned to particular colours or panes; the attractor/atlas distinction kept (an attractor organising trajectories is not an atlas of charts); Gebser used through page-specific paraphrase; notebook passages not promoted to edition-verified quotations. Mythemic verbs only: the window demonstrates transmission-with-obstruction; the seams retain provenance.

Automation: auto-spectrum (the light's breathing), auto-projection (the shifting cast), auto-return (recognition answerable) — tied to the record's moves; #0 and #2 held without automation (the entry and the seam are still). Durations 12–15, transitions 1.3–2.0; the return held longest.
